1.title: Investigating Microsoft 365 Activities: Audit, Content Search and Graph Activity Logs
1.text: Welcome to Module fifteen: Investigating Microsoft three sixty-five Activities: Audit, Content Search and Graph Activity Logs. It covers the exam area two. Respond to security incidents. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do four things. Investigate threats by using Microsoft Purview Audit. Investigate threats by using Content search in Microsoft Purview e discovery. Investigate threats by using Microsoft Graph activity logs. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Exam area: two. Respond to security incidents (thirty-five to forty percent). Exam format: one hundred minutes; a score of seven hundred on a scale of one to one thousand passes. Validated against: the official Microsoft S C-two hundred study guide and Microsoft Learn.

1.title: Three sources, three questions
1.text: Three sources, three questions. The figure shows this: Audit shows who did what, Content search finds the content, Graph activity logs show A P I calls.

1.title: Three sources, three questions, continued
1.text: Three sources, three questions. Microsoft Purview Audit. Who did what, and when? (sign-ins, file access, mailbox activity, admin changes). Content search (Purview e discovery). Where is this message or file? Find, preview, export and purge content. Microsoft Graph activity logs. Which app or user called the Graph A P I, and what did it request?

1.title: Microsoft Purview Audit
1.text: Microsoft Purview Audit. Audit (Standard) and Audit (Premium) are both enabled by default. Default retention. Standard: one hundred eighty days. Premium: One year for Entra, Exchange, One Drive, Share Point; one hundred eighty days for other workloads. Longer retention. Standard: None. Premium: Policies up to one year, or ten years with the per-user ten-Year Audit Log Retention add-on (not retroactive). Extra events. Standard: Core events. Premium: Mail Items Accessed, Send, Search Query Initiated Exchange and intelligent insights. Search export. Standard: fifty thousand rows. Premium: one million rows.

1.title: Microsoft Purview Audit, continued
1.text: Microsoft Purview Audit. Non-user records (service principals, system events) are kept one year and cannot be changed. Path. Purview portal, then Audit, then Search. Defaults. Last seven days (U T C); maximum range one hundred eighty days. Filters. Admin units, activities, record types, users, file or folder or site, workloads. Keyword search. Only the indexed common-schema fields, not the whole Audit Data blob. Limits. ten parallel search jobs per user; one unfiltered job; completed jobs kept thirty days. Latency. Core services sixty to ninety minutes.

1.title: Microsoft Purview Audit, continued
1.text: Microsoft Purview Audit. Audit Manager (role group). Search, export, and turn auditing on or off. Audit Reader. Search and export only. Audit Logs or View-Only Audit Logs. The underlying roles. Power Shell (Exchange Online): Get Admin Audit Log Config shows the setting Unified Audit Log Ingestion Enabled; Set Admin Audit Log Config -Unified Audit Log Ingestion Enabled true enables it; Search Unified Audit Log searches. Search Query Initiated Exchange must be enabled per mailbox with Set Mailbox and the Audit Owner setting. Exam tip: Standard equals one hundred eighty days. Premium equals one year by default, up to ten years with the add-on. Audit Reader can search; Audit Manager can also change settings.

1.title: Content search in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery
1.text: Content search in Microsoft Purview e discovery. The classic e discovery and Content search tools retired on August thirty-one, twenty twenty-five. The content search capability continues in the new Microsoft Purview e discovery experience. Create. Name, Locations (Exchange mailboxes, Share Point sites, public folders), Conditions, Submit. Keyword query. Operators and, or, not, N E A R; a keyword list can have up to twenty rows. Review. Statistics (match counts per keyword), preview, export. Role. e discovery Manager (Compliance Search to search).

1.title: Search and purge
1.text: Search and purge. Use it to remove a malicious message from mailboxes. Commands run in Security and Compliance Power Shell. Search. New-Compliance Search then Start-Compliance Search. Purge. New-Compliance Search Action -Search Name "name" -Purge -Purge Type Soft Delete or Hard Delete. Check. Get-Compliance Search Action (the action is named name Purge).

1.title: Search and purge, continued
1.text: Search and purge. Soft Delete. Moves to Recoverable Items Deletions; the user can recover it. Hard Delete. Moves to the Purges folder; removed permanently. Limits. ten items per mailbox per purge; fifty thousand mailboxes per search; not for mailboxes on litigation or in-place hold. Not deleted. Teams chat, Share Point and One Drive content, unindexed items. Roles. Compliance Search or e discovery Manager to search; Search And Purge to purge. Missing role. Error "A parameter cannot be found that matches parameter name 'Purge'". With Defender for Office three sixty-five Plan two, use Threat Explorer remediation instead (Module eleven). Exam tip: The "Purge parameter not found" error means the Search And Purge role is missing. Teams chat and Share Point files are not purged by this method.

1.title: Microsoft Graph activity logs
1.text: Microsoft Graph activity logs. Graph activity logs record every request to the Microsoft Graph A P I for your tenant. Table: Microsoft Graph Activity Logs. License. Microsoft Entra I D P one or P two. Enable. Diagnostic settings for the Microsoft Graph activity logs category; role Security Administrator. Destinations. Log Analytics workspace, storage account, event hub. Filtering. Cannot be filtered in diagnostic settings; use workspace transformations or the Basic plan to cut cost. Latency. Usually thirty minutes, up to two hours. Blind spot. Multitenant apps in other tenants. Warning. Secrets in request U R Is are logged.

1.title: Microsoft Graph activity logs, continued
1.text: Microsoft Graph activity logs. Key columns: App Id, User Id, Service Principal Id, I P Address, Request Uri, Request Method, Response Status Code, Client Auth Method (zero public, one secret, two certificate), Unique Token Id, Sign In Activity Id, Scopes, Roles. Use it to detect abnormal call volume, new privileged app permissions, a compromised user's A P I activity, and to join with Signin Logs on Sign In Activity Id (equals Unique Token Identifier). Exam tip: Graph activity logs have to be turned on; they are not on by default. Join to sign-in logs to find how a token was obtained.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. An analyst must find who deleted files from a Share Point site one hundred days ago. The organization has Audit (Standard). Where should the analyst search? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: The Purview portal Audit search over the last one hundred days. Audit search covers activities within the one hundred eighty-day Standard retention.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. Compliance requires keeping audit records of mailbox access for ten years for selected users. What is needed? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Audit (Premium) with a policy and the ten-Year Audit Log Retention add-on. Premium policies can keep records for ten years with the per-user add-on; it is not retroactive.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. A user needs to search and export audit logs but must not turn auditing on or off. Which role group fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Audit Reader, which can only search and export. Audit Reader can search and export; Audit Manager can also enable or disable auditing.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. An analyst runs New-Compliance Search Action with -Purge and gets an error that the Purge parameter cannot be found. What is missing? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: The Search And Purge role for the account. The Purge parameter appears only for accounts that hold the Search And Purge role.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. A phishing message must be removed so that users can still recover it for a while. Which purge type should be used? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Soft Delete, which moves items to Recoverable Items Deletions. Soft Delete keeps items in Recoverable Items Deletions where they can be recovered.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. A sock suspects a stolen app token is being used to read mail through the Graph A P I. Which data source shows the requests? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: The Microsoft Graph Activity Logs table from Entra diagnostic settings. Graph activity logs record the A P I requests with app, user, I P and U R I, once diagnostic settings send them to a workspace.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. What is the Audit (Standard) retention? Answer: one hundred eighty days. Question two. What is the maximum audit search range? Answer: one hundred eighty days. Question three. What is the purge limit per mailbox? Answer: ten items per mailbox per purge.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. Which license is needed for Graph activity logs? Answer: Microsoft Entra I D P one or P two. Question five. Which cmdlet enables unified audit log ingestion? Answer: Set-Admin Audit Log Config -Unified Audit Log Ingestion Enabled $true. Question six. Which content is not purged by search and purge? Answer: Teams chat, Share Point and One Drive content.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Audit: Standard one hundred eighty days; Premium one year, ten years with add-on. Search: Purview, then Audit, then Search; seven days default, one hundred eighty days maximum; Search-Unified Audit Log. Content search: locations, conditions, keywords; e discovery Manager; classic tools retired Aug thirty-one, twenty twenty-five. Purge: Soft Delete or Hard Delete; Search And Purge; ten items per mailbox. Graph activity logs: Microsoft Graph Activity Logs; diagnostic settings; Entra I D P one; Security Administrator.
